newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Parkway in India, Nepal health deal-paper.
newsitem.headline: Parkway in India, Nepal health deal-paper.

text.p: Singapore's Parkway Holdings is partnering India's Escorts Ltd in a wide range of healthcare facilities in India and Nepal, the daily Business Times newspaper said on Wednesday.
The parties signed a memorandum of understanding this week, said BT.

The venture's initial plan was to invest about Singapore $250 million to establish seven to eight hospitals in Indian cities within the next three years, it said. The focus would be on building or acquiring hospitals and diagnostic centres.
Parkway currently has a project to build a hospital in Calcutta with India's Duncan Industries.
Escorts representative N Trehan told BT the parties planned to partner Nepalese group Choudhary to build an acute-care hospital.
A listing of the healthcare business might be considered if the need arose, Trehan said.
